questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign warns you that you are near a school or school crossing. Be alert and prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the traffic rule. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn left where this sign is posted. Turning left is unsafe and illegal at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and wait for a crossing guard to signal you.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign shows you are near a school. Be ready to stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be prepared to stop if you see or hear one. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is pulled by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm equipment display this emblem. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is put on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to move right of a barrier or island. The road ahead is split into two sides.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign warns of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of an intersection ahead so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers of a school zone. It shows where children or pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming conditions, including sharp curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
The road will get narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a dangerous hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means you are approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs are used in construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that lanes are reducing ahead and you need to move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Move in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you to move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that a side road will enter ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn left only on a green arrow.
Turn left on green when it is safe.
Wait for a solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left on green when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass first. Then you may proceed.
